<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/returns/{rmaId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the RMA with its status, window and version. 404 `rma-not-found` for an id no RMA has; 400 for an id longer than 64 characters or holding a space, tab or `/`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>

  parameters={[{"name":"rmaId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The RMA id (service-minted ids look like `rma-<suffix>`; the prefix is not enforced). 1-64 characters without a space, tab or `/`; any other value is 400, and an unknown id of this shape is 404.","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64,"pattern":"^[^ \\t/]+$"},"example":"rma-4d5e6f7a-8b9c-4d0e-a1f2-3b4c5d6e7f80"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
